decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location plan (unnumbered, no date), 01, Design and Access Statement (no reference, no date). Received on 24 November 2015. Amended plans reference: 02, 03, 04, 05. Received on 22 December 2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension incorporating two front roof windows to the house
